objective: Evaluate causal transport within a fixed head fiber using calibrated interventions.
context: Tied four-visit F11 arithmetic model, linear readout head, shared TopK SAE, calibration-fit rank-four frames, held-out donor/recipient pairs and matched L2 norms. LayerNorm makes the linear fiber an incomplete nonlinear guarantee.

steps.name: State and head
steps.description: Define the hidden space, readout map and its fiber.

steps.name: Calibration
steps.description: Fit a gradient-transport frame using calibration margins only.

steps.name: Freeze
steps.description: Specify the admissible information at held-out time.

steps.name: Intervention
steps.description: Drive every frame from the same donor-recipient difference at equal norm.

steps.name: Evidence audit
steps.description: Compare controls, seed dependence, primary gate and limitations.

specific_questions.prompt: Derive why a vector in the kernel of a linear head may change the post-LayerNorm output. Construct a numerical witness.
Explain which statistical unit should govern inference for dependent pairs within one model seed.

native_verifier: SCM-23 compact_replay.py and independent receipt auditor; private checkpoint claims separate.
